header: Spot freight bookings against a fixed weekly slot
subheadline: Both options move the same pallet on the same network. The difference shows up in what you pay in week 46, and in whether a trailer position is already reserved when your production plan changes on a Tuesday afternoon.
left_description: You call the depot when a load is ready and take whatever capacity is free that day. Rates follow the market, so a Vienna to Rotterdam pallet ranges from EUR 96 in February to EUR 174 in peak weeks.

left_points.text: Rate quoted per load, valid 48 hours
Capacity subject to availability in peak weeks
Booking cut-off at 14:00 the day before

right_description: A reserved trailer position on a scheduled departure, priced for twelve months. Vienna to Rotterdam sits at EUR 118 per euro pallet, and the slot stays yours whether you fill it in week 7 or week 46.

right_points.text: EUR 118 per euro pallet, fixed for 12 months
Trailer position reserved on every departure
Booking cut-off at 18:00 on departure day
Live tracking events in the shipper portal
Named depot contact and a 24/7 escalation line
